info.title: RelayForge milestone 8 API
info.description: Tenant-authorized durable webhook API with private OpenTelemetry metrics, optional OTLP/HTTP tracing and stored acceptance-to-dispatch links. The public API has no /metrics route. Readiness checks critical sender schema/PostgreSQL; worker readiness also checks configured Redis. Collector export failure is noncritical. Correlation metadata does not change immutable outgoing bytes.

post.description: The unexpired same key+exact incoming bytes returns the original 202 body. Different bytes return 409. Seven-day TTL; expired-key reuse can create a new event. Outbound delivery is not performed here. New work is limited by MAX_TENANT_BACKLOG (default 10000 live pending/retry/in-flight deliveries per tenant); matching prior idempotency acceptance bypasses this capacity check. Zero-target events require no delivery slots.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Original saved response reused; this does not replay a delivery.

post.description: Requires an empty JSON object. Key scope is tenant + delivery; a key identifies one saved replay for the retained record lifetime. Same-key retries return the identical acceptance after later delivery/endpoint changes. New keys require dead-letter state, an enabled nondeleted endpoint, and an event within its 30-day retention window. Increment cycle, reset cycle attempts/deadline, preserve lifetime attempts, IDs, raw body, URL snapshot, and old attempts. Delivered, pending, retry-scheduled, in-flight, and cancelled work returns 409 for a new key. Replay does not reroute an old URL. A new replay needs one live-delivery backlog slot. Existing replay receipts are returned before the capacity check.
